[RCTS.1.2.1] A fixture is one JSON object, and no object in it, at any depth,
repeats a member name; a harness must refuse a fixture that does
([RCTS.1.2.15]). It must carry `id`, `category`,
`scenario`, `rules_ds` and `expect`. Of its optional fields, `deprecated`,
`platform_dependent`, `libraries`, `files`, `clauses`, `dead_rules_expected`
and `witnesses` have the meaning given below; a `stdlib` member makes it
malformed ([RCTS.1.2.14]);
any other is advisory to a harness and does not decide whether the fixture passes:
